board: NUCLEO-F401RE (STM32F401RE, 84 MHz), powered from the laptop's USB port through the meter
meter: Joy-IT JT-UM120 USB tester, between the laptop's USB port and the board; display resolution 1 mV, 1 mA, 1 mW as read
regulator: assumed linear (Nucleo-64 boards feed the MCU's 3.3 V from an LDO; the board manual UM1724 could not be downloaded on 2026-10-16 to confirm the part)
